label: Create Sketch

label: Edit Sketch

label: Finish Sketch

label: Cancel Sketch
params: Leaves the sketch without keeping what changed since it was created or opened for editing: the design goes back to how it was then (a new sketch is removed), as one step that Undo brings back. Refused when the undo history no longer leads back to that point (use Undo instead). restore_marker?: bool (default true); false transfers the temporary marker to another editor

label: Line

label: Sketch Dimension
params: entities: [refs] (a line midpoint is "mid:line_id"; a model edge or vertex, {edge: [x,y,z], body?} or {vertex: [x,y,z], body?}, is projected into the sketch first and measured there: a point against the projected edge measures the distance to it), type?: auto|distance|horizontal|distance_x|vertical|distance_y|length|radius|diameter|angle, value?: number or expression (default: current; a bare number is in the design's units, e.g. 2 means 2 in in an inch design; give a unit such as "50 mm" to override), or `name = expression` (e.g. "width = 40"; also `#name = expression`), which adds the user parameter `name` with that expression and dimensions with `name` (refused when the name is taken or reserved; the reply's `defined` names it); text_at?: [x, y]. Two points, two midpoints or a line off the axes: with auto, text_at inside the box they span (as opposite corners) or in its outer corners is the distance between them, above or below the box horizontal, beside it vertical. Two lines: the angle between them (acute, or 180° − it when the value is nearer that) unless text_at picks a sector. A line and a circle or arc: the distance from the line to its edge (the gap, or how far the edge reaches past a line that cuts it; 0 is tangent); dimension the centre point for the distance to the centre. A point and a circle or arc: the distance from the point to its edge (or how far within it a point inside lies). Two circles or arcs: the gap between their edges (or how far they overlap when they cross, or the narrowest gap between them when one lies inside the other), or the centre-to-centre distance when they are the two caps of a slot. An arc and one of its end points: the arc's length (type arc_length does it from the arc alone). A dimension the sketch already determines is refused (naming what determines it); if_redundant?: "driven" places it as a driven (reference) dimension instead. scale_sketch?: bool (the dimension tool sends true): when this is the sketch's first length dimension and nothing in the sketch fixes a size (no other driving length dimension, nothing fixed or projected), the whole sketch scales about its origin to the value instead of distorting. Returns measured in unit (mm or deg), and scaled: the factor when the sketch was scaled

label: Horizontal/Vertical
params: line: id | points: [a, b] (point ids or {midpoint: line_id}; accepted midpoints reuse or create a point with a Midpoint constraint); mode?: horizontal|vertical

label: Coincident
params: a, b: points (or a line's middle as {midpoint: line}, which becomes a point tied there), a point and a curve or sketch axis (x / y: the sketch's own axes, unless a curve has that id; an axis becomes a linked construction line on it, reported in created), or two distinct lines (joins their closest endpoints), or two circles/arcs (the second lies on the first: concentric and equal, `constraints` lists both); any of them may be a model edge {edge: [x,y,z], body?} or vertex {vertex: [x,y,z], body?}, projected into the sketch first (reported in created)

label: Tangent
params: a, b: curves or sketch axes (x / y: the sketch's own axes, unless a curve has that id; an axis becomes a linked construction line on it, reported in created); any of them may be a model edge {edge: [x,y,z], body?} or vertex {vertex: [x,y,z], body?}, projected into the sketch first (reported in created)

label: Equal
params: a, b: lines or circles/arcs; or curves: [2 to 200 lines or circles/arcs], each made equal to the first, in one step; any of them may be a model edge {edge: [x,y,z], body?} or vertex {vertex: [x,y,z], body?}, projected into the sketch first (reported in created)

label: Parallel
params: a, b: lines or sketch axes (x / y: the sketch's own axes, unless a curve has that id; an axis becomes a linked construction line on it, reported in created); any of them may be a model edge {edge: [x,y,z], body?} or vertex {vertex: [x,y,z], body?}, projected into the sketch first (reported in created)

label: Perpendicular
params: a, b: lines or sketch axes (x / y: the sketch's own axes, unless a curve has that id; an axis becomes a linked construction line on it, reported in created); any of them may be a model edge {edge: [x,y,z], body?} or vertex {vertex: [x,y,z], body?}, projected into the sketch first (reported in created)

label: Fix/UnFix
params: entity: point or curve | entities: [points and curves]; fixed?: bool (default: fix them all unless all are fixed, then unfix)

label: MidPoint
params: point, line | a, b in pick order: a point and a line (either way round), or two lines whose midpoints meet (the first stays, the second moves); any of them may be a model edge {edge: [x,y,z], body?} or vertex {vertex: [x,y,z], body?}, projected into the sketch first (reported in created)

label: Concentric
params: a, b: two circles/arcs, or a circle/arc and a sketch point (including origin), in either order; the point and the curve's centre become coincident; any of them may be a model edge {edge: [x,y,z], body?} or vertex {vertex: [x,y,z], body?}, projected into the sketch first (reported in created)

label: Collinear
params: a, b: lines or sketch axes (x / y: the sketch's own axes, unless a curve has that id; an axis becomes a linked construction line on it, reported in created); any of them may be a model edge {edge: [x,y,z], body?} or vertex {vertex: [x,y,z], body?}, projected into the sketch first (reported in created)

label: Symmetry
params: a, b: two points or two curves (lines mirror their ends, circles/arcs their centres); line: symmetry line id, or x / y for the sketch's own axes (a curve with that id wins; an axis becomes a linked construction line on it, reported in created); or point (or a point id as line, "origin" too): symmetric about that point, each pair joined by a construction line it is the midpoint of; any of them may be a model edge {edge: [x,y,z], body?} or vertex {vertex: [x,y,z], body?}, projected into the sketch first (reported in created)

label: Normal/Construction
params: curves: [ids], value?: bool (default: construction unless all of them already are)

label: Delete Sketch Entities
params: entities: [curve, point or constraint ids]

label: Drag Sketch Point
params: point: ref, to: [x,y]

label: Drag Sketch Geometry
params: entity: point or curve, from: [x,y] where it was grabbed, to: [x,y], live?: bool: points and the material point grabbed on a line move toward `to` within the design constraints. When exact placement is impossible, bounded feasible steps minimize cursor distance. Splines slide by to - from; a circle or arc grabbed on its edge takes the radius to `to`. `with?`: [point or curve ids] moves the rest of a selection with the entity as one translation (circles keep their radii). Long moves retain the solution branch; arcs cannot sweep through their starts. Returns `reached`: progress projected onto the requested move (0..1), `at`: the grabbed position for the next frame, and `retry`: budget-limited progress can continue in another frame. `live: true` shares a work budget across held-solve decomposition and cursor correction; ordinary recovery and the final model evaluation retain their existing limits, not a wall-clock deadline. Later features stay stale until `sketch.drag_end`; `dof` stays from before the drag

label: End Sketch Drag
params: constraint?: {command: a sketch.constraint.* id, params}: ends a drag made of `sketch.drag` `live: true` frames: adds the constraint it let go on (not kept if it over-constrains the sketch), then evaluates the whole model once; returns the constraint's result and the sketch's solved state and degrees of freedom

label: Move Dimension Text
params: dimension: constraint id or parameter name; at: [x,y] text centre (sketch coordinates) | reset: true (default place)

label: Sketch Palette Options
params: sketch?: id|name (default active); any of show_profile, show_points, show_dimensions, show_constraints, show_projected, show_construction, grid, snap, slice, sketch_3d: bool. Returns them all

label: Chain
params: curve: id: the curves joined to it end to end (what a double-click selects)

label: Solve Sketch
params: reports the solver status and degrees of freedom

label: Midpoint Line
params: mid: [x,y], point ref or snap ("mid:<line>", "on:<curve>:x,y", model vertex/edge); end: [x,y]; construction?. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Tangent Arc
params: start: end point of a line or arc ("l1.end"), end: [x,y] or an existing point's id ("l2.start": the arc ends on that point); curve?: the curve to be tangent to (default: the one ending at start). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

params: curves: [two lines/circles/arcs], radius | diameter: expr, near: [x,y] (which of the solutions). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: 3-Tangent Circle
params: curves: [three lines/circles/arcs], near: [x,y] (which of the solutions). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Center Point Slot
params: center: slot centre, end: one arc centre, width. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Three Point Arc Slot
params: start, through, end: points on the centre arc, width. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Center Point Arc Slot
params: center, start: centre arc start, end: direction of the centre arc end (counter-clockwise) or sweep: degrees (0 < sweep < 360), width; returns centre_arc. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Ellipse
params: center, major: end of the major axis [x,y], minor: a point the ellipse passes through on the minor side [x,y] | minor_radius. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Fit Point Spline
params: points: [[x,y] or point refs…] (2…500): the spline passes through them, periodic?: boolean (default false); periodic cubic fit closes smoothly through at least 3 distinct samples. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

params: points: control points (2…500), cubic. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Control Point Spline (Degree 5)
params: points: control points (2…500), degree 5. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Add Spline Point
params: curve: fit point spline id, at: [x,y]: a fit point is inserted where the curve passes nearest to it, between its neighbours (the curve still runs through it and all its old points; constraints on them stay); end?: start|end: `at` becomes the spline's new first or last point instead, and the curve runs on to it (refused when that end is joined to other geometry). Control point splines take no new points yet. Returns point: the new point's id

label: Remove Spline Point
params: curve: spline id, point: one of its points (a point id, or the curve's start or end such as s1.end): the spline runs through (or over) its other points only, and the point goes with the constraints on it unless another curve uses it. Fit point, control point and closed splines. Refused for a closed spline's closing point, for an end joined to other geometry or held by a constraint, when fewer than 2 points would be left (3 on a closed spline), and for a projected, offset or patterned spline. Returns curve, point: the point's id, deleted: whether the point went too

label: Reverse Spline Direction
params: curve: spline id (fit point, control point or closed): its last point becomes its first and the curve runs the other way along the same path; its points and the constraints on them stay. Refused for a projected spline and for one an offset uses or makes. Returns curve

label: Conic Curve
params: start, end, apex: [x,y] or point refs; rho?: 0…1 (default 0.5: parabola). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Blend Curve
params: a, b: end points of two curves ("l1.end", "a2.start"), continuity?: g1|g2|g3|g4 (default g1: a tangent spline; g2…g4 match the reference curves' curvature, curvature rate and 4th derivative as well, as one Bézier of degree 5, 7 or 9). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Centerline
params: curves: [line ids], value?: bool (default toggles): centerline line type (not in profiles; an axis)

label: Infinite Line
params: curves: [line ids], value?: bool (default toggles): infinite line type (#1359): construction geometry drawn across the whole view through the line's two points; off, a normal line

label: Text
params: text: string (\n breaks lines), or text_expression: the words built from text parameters (parameters.add with unit text), number parameters and quoted texts joined by + ("Label + '-L'", "'W' + Width"; a number parameter shows its value in the design's units, "85 mm", an angle in degrees, "30°"; number(Width) is the number alone and number(Width, 2) has 2 decimals): the text keeps it, its words follow the parameters (a parameter edit or a configuration row relabels it) and `exprs` returns it as `text`; at: baseline start [x,y], height?: capital height mm (default 5), angle?: deg; at's x and y, height and angle each take a number or an expression over the design's parameters as a string ("plate_width / 2", "label_size"): the text keeps the expression, follows the parameters, and returns it in `exprs`; an expression naming no parameter is the number it comes to, a bare number in one is in the design's units, font?: an installed font's family or full name, or a .ttf/.otf file path (~ and %VAR% expand; default: the built-in Liberation Sans), bold?, italic?: bool (an installed family's bold or italic face; italic without one is slanted), align?: left|center|right (the lines against `at`, or along the path), letter_spacing?: extra mm between letters, line_spacing?: times the font's line distance (default 1), path?: a curve id of the sketch the baseline follows ("": none; `at` and `angle` then do not place the text; the curve becomes construction, a guide the letters stand on), reverse?: bool (the other way along the path). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Edit Text
params: link: the text's link id (or entity: one of its curves), text? or text_expression? (as in sketch.text; typed words replace the expression), at?, height?, angle?: deg (numbers or expressions as in sketch.text; a number replaces an expression, and so does moving the text), font?: family or file path (empty: the built-in font), bold?, italic?: bool (an installed family's bold or italic face; italic without one is slanted), align?: left|center|right (the lines against `at`, or along the path), letter_spacing?: extra mm between letters, line_spacing?: times the font's line distance (default 1), path?: a curve id of the sketch the baseline follows ("": none; `at` and `angle` then do not place the text; the curve becomes construction, a guide the letters stand on), reverse?: bool (the other way along the path) (each kept when left out); or edits: [{link or entity, text?, at?, …}]: several texts changed together, the design rebuilt once (all or nothing; returns edits: each one's result); live?: bool: one frame of an interactive change (the sketch is solved, the features after it stay as they were until `sketch.drag_end`). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Construction Line
params: Construction line, free. at: point; through?: second point; curve?, curve2?: sketch references; angle?: degrees from sketch X; near?: solution selector, and the side a line with a length runs towards; solution?: zero-based solution index; length?: a segment of this length from `at`, held by a length dimension, instead of an infinite line (horizontal, vertical, angle, parallel, perpendicular); construction?: false makes that segment a normal line. Tangents take circles/arcs, or an open spline/conic endpoint for tangent_at.. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Horizontal Construction Line
params: Construction line, horizontal. at: point; through?: second point; curve?, curve2?: sketch references; angle?: degrees from sketch X; near?: solution selector, and the side a line with a length runs towards; solution?: zero-based solution index; length?: a segment of this length from `at`, held by a length dimension, instead of an infinite line (horizontal, vertical, angle, parallel, perpendicular); construction?: false makes that segment a normal line. Tangents take circles/arcs, or an open spline/conic endpoint for tangent_at.. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

params: Construction line, vertical. at: point; through?: second point; curve?, curve2?: sketch references; angle?: degrees from sketch X; near?: solution selector, and the side a line with a length runs towards; solution?: zero-based solution index; length?: a segment of this length from `at`, held by a length dimension, instead of an infinite line (horizontal, vertical, angle, parallel, perpendicular); construction?: false makes that segment a normal line. Tangents take circles/arcs, or an open spline/conic endpoint for tangent_at.. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Equation Curve
params: x: x(t), y: y(t): formulas of t in the design's expression language and parameters ("r * (cos(t) + t * sin(t))"); or explicit: true and y: f(x) alone (no x); start, end: the range of t (or of x): a number or an expression ("2 * pi", "360 deg" is 2·pi, a length is in the design's unit); tolerance?: mm (default 0.01): how far the curve may stray from the formulas (0.0001 to 10); construction?: bool; variable_unit?: "number" (default) or "range". The variable is a plain number: sin(t) reads it in radians; a result without a unit is in the design's length unit. With variable_unit "range" it is a length, so a ^ 2 / (4 * t) is a length when a is one: start and end must both be lengths, or one a length and the other a plain number, which is then in the design's unit. Makes a fit point spline through fixed points, as many as the tolerance needs (up to 500), closed smoothly when it ends where it starts; the points are placed again from the formulas whenever the parameters change. Returns curve, points (how many), closed, deviation (mm). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Equal Distance Chamfer
params: point | points: [corners] (every corner cut alike; a corner is a point reference or {a, b}) | a, b: a corner of two lines (two that share no end are first brought to where they meet, as in sketch.fillet); distance. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Distance and Angle Chamfer
params: point | points: [corners] (every corner cut alike; a corner is a point reference or {a, b}, and a point's `a` is the first of its two lines in curve order) | a, b: a corner of two lines (two that share no end are first brought to where they meet, as in sketch.fillet); distance: along a, angle: deg from a. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Two Distance Chamfer
params: point | points: [corners] (every corner cut alike; a corner is a point reference or {a, b}, and a point's `a` is the first of its two lines in curve order) | a, b: a corner of two lines (two that share no end are first brought to where they meet, as in sketch.fillet); distance: along a, distance2: along b. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Offset
params: curves: [ids], distance: number in mm or length expression (creates an editable dimension; positive = left of the chain, or toward `side`), side?: [x,y], chain?: bool (default true: the connected chain, including ends that only coincide). A corner is trimmed back to the crossing when the offset runs past it, and extended until the offset curves intersect when the corner falls short; direction?: one_side|symmetric (default one_side) or symmetric?: bool (the same distance each way; no `side`, whose job it takes over), distance2?: positive length expression (Two Sides: an independent distance the other way, as for `solid.extrude`). Each side is its own offset association, listed in `sides`; flip?: bool reverses the primary side; `param`/`param2` name the driving dimensions; instances?: whole number or unitless expression, 1…100 (default 1): each instance after the first offsets the instance before it by the same distance again, so instance n stands n distances from the curves picked. Every instance of a side is driven by that side's own dimension, and each entry of `sides` names its `instance`; an instance the shape cannot take refuses the whole command. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Break Offset Association
params: curve: derived offset curve id (retains geometry and makes its points editable)

label: Trim
params: curve: id, at: [x,y] (the piece to remove: between the nearest intersections around it). Trimming a line source releases its dependent straight offsets' linked extents (offset_released: curve ids), retaining their driving normal-distance dimensions and parallel relations. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Trim Along Path
params: points: [[x,y]…] (2…2000 positions: a path drawn across the sketch). Every piece the path crosses is removed as `sketch.trim` removes the piece at that crossing, in the order the path crosses them; a piece crossed again after it is gone is not trimmed twice; projected geometry, infinite lines, offset outputs and pieces trim refuses are passed over (why in `skipped`). dry_run?: bool (report without changing the design). One undo step → trimmed: [each trim's result], removed: [[[x,y]…]] (each removed piece as a polyline). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Extend
params: curve: id, at: [x,y] near the end to extend (a line runs on to the nearest curve, or the previewed reach when nothing is in the way; an arc grows along its circle and closes into a whole circle when nothing stops it) | curves: [id, id] (two lines or arcs of this sketch, grown until they meet and joined there), at?: [[x,y],[x,y]] (one point per curve: the end to grow; default the end nearest the meeting point). `curve` and `curves` exclude each other; the two-curve form returns moved: the meeting point's id

label: Break
params: curve: id, at: [x,y] (split at intersections) | points: [[x,y]…] (1…1000 positions projected onto the curve; duplicates are merged). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Sketch Scale
params: entities: [curve/point ids], base: [x,y] or point ref, factor: number

label: Transform
params: entities: [curve/point ids], factor?: number (scale), angle?: degrees (turn), center?: [x,y] or point ref (what scales and turns stay put; default [0,0]), translate?: [dx,dy] (applied last); scales, turns and moves in one step

label: Move/Copy Sketch Entities
params: entities: [ids], translate?: [dx,dy], angle?: deg, center?: [x,y], copy?: bool, rotate_constraints?: bool (default true; false keeps constraints unchanged); a rotation turns the constraints tied to the sketch axes when all their geometry moves (horizontal and vertical relations and dimensions swap at odd quarter turns and stay at half turns, line angles turn with the line) and removes the horizontal and vertical ones that cannot hold at other angles; picking a text outline or linked point transforms its whole text source once, and copies remain editable text; copy also accepts drawn 3D curves, preserving exact arcs and height above the sketch plane. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Mirror
params: entities: [curve/point ids], line: straight curve id, x / y for a sketch axis, or {axis: X|Y|Z} for an origin axis in the sketch plane (symmetry constraints are added). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Circular Pattern
params: entities: [ids], center: [x,y] or point ref, count: 2…500 (number or unitless expression, retained through edits), angle?: total deg, number or expression (default 360); alignment?: left|center|right (default right); reversed?: bool (default false). Quantity includes the original. Center balances copies around it; reversed flips the direction and extra side for even totals. Partial arcs span angle with angle/(count-1) spacing; full turns use angle/count. Adds associative pattern constraints; a coordinate center creates a constrainable point. Returns pattern and center ids. pattern?: existing pattern id to edit (omitted values retained; surviving instance ids retained). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Rectangular Pattern
params: entities: [ids], count, spacing; count2?, spacing2?; counts: positive integer numbers or expressions, at most 500 instances total; spacings: length numbers or expressions; direction?, direction2?: sketch line ids (live references); dir?, dir2?: [x,y] vectors (defaults: sketch x, perpendicular to direction 1); alignment?, alignment2?: left|center|right (default right). Signed spacings reverse each direction. reversed?, reversed2?: bool (default false); reverses placement and the extra side of even centered totals. Quantities include the original. Adds associative pattern constraints. Returns pattern id. pattern?: existing pattern id to edit (omitted values retained; surviving instance ids retained). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Project
params: refs: [{edge: [x,y,z], body?} | {face: [x,y,z], body?} (its edge loops) | {body: name} (silhouette) | {vertex: [x,y,z], body?} | {sketch, curve} | {sketch, point} | "origin" | {axis: X|Y|Z|name} | {plane: XY|XZ|YZ|name}]; projection_link?: bool (default true). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Intersect
params: refs: [{body}, {face: [x,y,z], body?}, {edge: [x,y,z], body?}, {sketch, curve}]: section curves (or points) with the sketch plane; projection_link?: bool (default true). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Include 3D Geometry
params: refs: like Project (edges, vertices, sketch curves and points); curves out of the sketch plane are flattened onto it. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Project To Surface
params: curves: [{sketch, curve}…] (curves of other sketches), face: [x,y,z] point on the target face, body?: projected along the active sketch's normal onto the face, as linked 3D curves. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Intersection Curve
params: a, b: {body} | {face: [x,y,z], body?}: where they meet, as linked 3D curves. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Spun Profile
params: body: name, axis: a line of the active sketch (curve id) | X|Y|Z: the body's outline revolved about the axis, in the sketch plane. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Isoparametric Curve
params: face: [x,y,z] point on the face (the curve passes through it), body?, direction?: u|v|[x,y,z] (default u): linked 3D curve. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Fit Curves to Mesh Section
params: body: name (a mesh or solid body): its section with the sketch plane, fitted with lines and arcs, as normal (unlinked) geometry. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)

label: Break Link
params: link?: link id (j1) | entities?: [curve or point ids]: linked geometry becomes normal sketch geometry

label: Auto-Project Edges on Reference
params: value?: bool (default toggles): project a face's edges when a sketch is created on it

label: Extrude
params: distance: expr (or through_all: true); taper?: angle expr (positive: outward, so the far end is larger along the extrusion direction; negative: inward, so the far end is smaller); sketch?: id|name (default: active or last sketch); profiles?: all | [index] | [{curves: [ids]}] (the profile whose outer loop is made of exactly these curves, or pieces of them; found again on every recompute, so it follows parameter changes; islands inside are its holes; an error when no profile or several match) | [{point:[x,y]}] (index and point picks are stored by their curves when that finds the same profile; a pick on a drawn profile that reference geometry, such as the projected outline of the face the sketch is on, cuts into regions takes the whole drawn profile); exact_regions?: bool (each index or point pick is exactly the region it names, as the dialogs send); default: every drawn profile, except that a loop inside another is its hole and a loop inside that hole is material again; face?: [x,y,z] (extrude a planar body face instead of a sketch profile); faces?: [[x,y,z],…] (coplanar faces of one body); face_body?: name (whose face, where faces of several bodies meet at the point); direction?: positive|negative|symmetric (distance is total thickness, split evenly around the start plane); convention?: total_distance|legacy_per_side (default total_distance; legacy preserves older symmetric extents); distance2?: expr (Two Sides: a second distance the other way from the first side, which may be through_all or to; with direction: negative the first side goes against the normal and distance2 along it); start_offset?: expr (along the sketch normal, also with direction: negative); to?: [x,y,z] (To Object: a face, vertex or point; to_offset?: expr past it); from?: [x,y,z] (From Object: start at that face or point); operation?: new|join|cut|intersect|auto (cut into a body, otherwise join existing solids; new in an empty component); targets?: [body] (Join from a face, or from a sketch on a body's face, defaults to that face's body; explicit targets or participants override); name?; body_name?; thin?: true (Thin: a wall along sketch curves instead of the profiles) with curves?: [curve ids] (open chains and closed loops, joined where they meet end to end; default: every drawn curve of the sketch), thickness: expr, side?: center|inside|outside|two_sides (a closed loop's inside is the area it encloses, an open chain's the side it bends toward, a straight line's the left of its first curve as drawn; default center), thickness2?: expr (two_sides: the thickness outside); corners are mitred, crossing walls are one

label: Revolve
params: axis: sketch line id | x | y (sketch axes) | X|Y|Z (world) | {type: world, axis: X|Y|Z} (as returned by timeline.inspect) | construction axis name (followed when edited) | {origin, dir} | {edge|face: [x,y,z]} (a straight or circular edge, or a cylinder, cone or torus face: about its axis, followed as the model changes); angle?: expr (default 360 deg); angle2?: expr (Two Sides: the other side's angle); direction?: symmetric (angle split either side, independent of axis direction); convention?: sketch_normal|legacy_axis_start (default sketch_normal; legacy retains older angular starts); to?: [x,y,z] (To Object: turn until that face, vertex or point); sketch?, profiles? | face: [x,y,z] (a planar body face as the profile) and face_body?: name (whose face, where faces of several bodies meet), operation?, targets?, name?, body_name?

label: Sweep
params: sketch: profile sketch; profiles?; path_sketch: sketch; path: [curve ids in order]; orientation?: perpendicular (default: square to the path, turning with it) | parallel (as drawn: the profile moves without turning; the path must keep crossing its plane) | [x,y,z] (square to the path, its turn about the path fixed by this direction); twist?: angle expr (the profile turns this much about the path over its length; within 4 turns); scale?: expr (the profile's scale at the end, linear along the path; 0.01…100); rails?: [{sketch?: sketch (default path_sketch), curves: [curve ids in order]}] (guide rails, one or two, each meeting every plane square to the path once along it, from the end nearest the path's start: one rail turns the profile so its point where the rail starts stays on the rail and scales it with the rail's distance from the path; two rails carry it between them, its points where they start staying on both; rails take the default orientation, no twist and no scale, and a path without sharp corners); rail_fit?: scale (default: the profile grows and shrinks evenly) | stretch (only across to the rail, between the rails); operation?, targets?, name?, body_name?

label: Loft
params: sections: [{sketch, profiles?} | {sketch, point: id} (an apex)] (2…50, in order; matching hole counts, no holes at an apex); rails?: [{sketch, curves: [ids in order]}] (one or two guide rails from the first section to the last, through every section's outline: the loft follows them between the sections; not with sections that have holes); rail_fit?: scale|stretch (default scale: with one rail the sections grow evenly with the rail's distance from their middle, with two with the distance between the rails; stretch: only that way); operation?, targets? (Join excludes hidden bodies from automatic targets; explicit targets or participants may include them), name?, body_name?

label: Box
params: length, width, height: expr; corner?: [x,y,z] | center?: [x,y,z] (numbers in mm or length expressions; default: the origin); operation?, targets?: [body], name?, body_name?

label: Cylinder
params: radius | diameter, height: expr; base?: [x,y,z] (centre of the bottom: numbers in mm or length expressions; default: the origin); axis?: X|Y|Z|[x,y,z] (default Z); references?: [{edge: [x,y,z] on a straight edge of the face it stands on, distance: expr}] (at most two, as solid.hole's: the base centre goes that far from each edge's line, in the face's plane, and follows the edges; with a numeric base only); operation?, targets?: [body], name?, body_name?

label: Sphere
params: radius | diameter: expr; center?: [x,y,z] (numbers in mm or length expressions; default: the origin); operation?, targets?: [body], name?, body_name?

label: Torus
params: major, minor: expr (radii); center?: [x,y,z] (numbers in mm or length expressions; default: the origin); operation?, targets?: [body], name?, body_name?

label: Cone
params: radius | diameter, height: expr (the base circle, and the top's distance along the axis; a negative height goes the other way); top_radius? | top_diameter?: expr (the top circle; default 0: a full cone ending in an apex); base?: [x,y,z] (centre of the base circle: numbers in mm or length expressions; default: the origin); axis?: X|Y|Z|[x,y,z] (default Z); operation?, targets?: [body], name?, body_name?

label: Fillet
params: edges: [[x,y,z] point on edge | {body, index}]; radius: expr; body?; type?: constant|curvature (alias g2: curvature-continuous quintic between planar faces along straight edges, one planar end face at each end (including sloped ends); radius sets the equivalent circular setback, not constant curvature; exact fit only)|chord (radius is the width across)|variable (radius at the end nearest start, radius2 at the other; one end may be 0, where the round closes to the corner)|spline (the radius along the edge is a clamped B-spline from the end nearest start: radius is its first control radius, radii the rest, knots its knot vector from 0 to 1; one end may be 0); radius2?; start?: [x,y,z]; radii?: [expr, …]; knots?: [number, …]; mid?: [[position 0…1 from start, radius expr], …] (variable radii between the ends); smooth?: bool (smooth instead of straight between the radii); corner?: rolling|g2 (rolling, the default: the corners where three blended edges meet are pieces of the rolling ball's sphere, tangent to each blend; g2: a patch repeating each blend's surface up to the second order, constant-radius exact fillets only, refused where it cannot be built); fit?: exact|reduce|taper (exact, the default: a radius too large for the geometry around the edges is refused; reduce: where it doesn't fit it is reduced to the largest that does, one radius for edges sharing a face; the smallest used is returned as `radius_applied`, each edge's as `radii_applied: [{edge: [x,y,z], radius}]`, and noted in the feature's warning; taper: along each straight edge between planar faces where it doesn't fit, the radius follows the room there as a smooth spline, down to 0 where a face closes to a point, noted in the feature's warning)

label: Chamfer
params: edges: [[x,y,z] | {body, index}]; distance: expr; distance2?: expr (along the second face) | angle?: expr (from the first face); flip?: bool (which face is first: by default the one facing up most); body?

label: Combine
params: target: body; tools: [body]; operation?: join|cut|intersect; keep_tools?: bool; new_component?: bool (the result goes into a new component; component_name?)

label: Rectangular Pattern
params: features: [names] | bodies: [names] | components: [names]; dir1: [x,y,z]; count1; spacing1; dir2?, count2?, spacing2?; alignment?, alignment2?: left|center|right (default right; counts include the original); reversed?, reversed2?: bool (Flip)

label: Circular Pattern
params: features: [names] | bodies: [names] | components: [names]; axis: X|Y|Z | construction axis name (followed when edited) | {origin, dir} (origin coordinates may be length expressions; the pattern follows them) | {edge|face: [x,y,z]} (a straight or circular edge, or a cylinder, cone or torus face: about its axis, followed as the model changes); count; angle? (default 360 deg; partial arcs include both ends); alignment?: left|center|right (default right; original stays fixed); reversed?: bool (Flip; selects the extra side for even centered counts)

label: Pattern on Path
params: features: [names] | bodies: [names]; path_sketch: sketch; path: [curve ids in order]; count; spacing (between instances) | distance (first to last); orientation?: identical|path; flip?: bool

label: Mirror
params: features: [names] | bodies: [names] (combine?: join with the original); plane: XY|XZ|YZ|construction plane name or id|{origin, normal}|{origin, x_dir, y_dir} (origin coordinates may be length expressions; the mirror follows them, or a construction plane)

label: Hole
params: position: [x,y,z] on a face (numbers, or length expressions the hole follows) | sketch + points: [sketch point ids] (one hole each, perpendicular to the sketch, into the material on whichever side of the sketch plane it is) | sketch alone (every sketch point: standalone points and circle centres); flip?: bool (sketch points: drill to the other side); single?: bool (with one sketch point: a Single hole that follows the point, drilled into the face there); direction?: [x,y,z] (default: into the face, against its outward normal; one that leaves the face is mirrored into it; ignored with sketch points unless single); diameter | thread (a tapped hole: metric major minus pitch or tabulated UNC/UNF, G or Rp cut-tap drill) | clearance: "M6" with fit?: close|normal|loose (ISO 273); depth? (default through all) | to?: [x,y,z] (To Object: drill to that face or point); references?: [{edge: [x,y,z] on a straight edge of the face, distance: expr}] (at most two; the centre goes that far from each edge's line, in the face's plane, and follows the edges; with a numeric position only); type?: simple|drilled|counterbore|countersink; tip_angle?; cb_diameter?, cb_depth?; cs_diameter?, cs_angle?; thread?: "M6" or "1/4-20 UNC" (cosmetic); handedness?: right|left (default right, needs thread for left); thread_depth?: positive length independent of drill depth (default: full useful cylindrical wall; must fit that wall); targets?: [body] (the bodies to drill; holes at the points of a sketch on a body's face default to that body, found along the holes' direction on it alone; explicit targets or participants override, ["*"] every body)

label: Pipe
params: path_sketch: sketch; path: [curve ids in order]; diameter: expr; wall?: expr (hollow); operation?, targets?, name?, body_name?

label: Bounding Solid
params: bodies?: [names] (default: all); margin?: expr; name?, body_name?

label: Scale
params: bodies: [names]; factor: expr | factors: [x, y, z] exprs; origin?: [x,y,z]

label: Delete Face

label: Offset Face
params: faces: [[x,y,z] points on faces (planar or curved), or face names from model.faces]; distance: expr (positive: outward); body?

label: Thread
params: face: [x,y,z] on a cylindrical face; designation?: ISO metric ("M8", "M8x1"; default: the size that fits); length?: expr (default: the whole face); handedness?: right|left (default right); modeled?: bool (default false). Cosmetic: the model is unchanged, model.threads lists it. Modeled: cuts the thread profile into the body; a shaft thicker than the thread is first turned down to its major diameter over the threaded length

label: Shell
params: faces: [[x,y,z] points on the faces to remove, or face names from model.faces]; thickness: expr; direction?: inside|outside|both; tangent_chain?: bool (also open faces joined smoothly to the picked ones); body?

label: Draft
params: faces: [[x,y,z] points, or face names from model.faces]; angle: expr; neutral: XY|XZ|YZ|plane name|{origin, normal}; pull?: [x,y,z] (default: neutral plane normal); body?

label: Offset Plane
params: base: XY|XZ|YZ|plane name, or a planar face {face: [x,y,z], body?, index?, path?}; offset: expr, or through: a point ref (vertex, sketch point, construction point) the plane goes through, parallel to base; name?

label: Plane at Angle
params: base: XY|XZ|YZ|plane name, or a planar face {face: [x,y,z], body?, index?, path?}; axis: X|Y|Z|construction axis name (where it is now)|{origin, dir} | {edge|face: [x,y,z]} (a straight or circular edge, or a cylinder, cone or torus face: about its axis, followed as the model changes); angle: expr; name?

label: Split Face
params: faces: [[x,y,z] points on the faces to split, or face names from model.faces]; body?; and the splitting tool: plane: XY|XZ|YZ|plane name|{origin, normal} — or tool: {body, point} (a face of a body, its surface extended) — or sketch: id or name (its curves, along the sketch's normal)

label: Split Body
params: body: name; plane: XY|XZ|YZ|plane name|{origin, normal} — or tool: {body, point} (a face of a body, its surface extended) — or sketch: id, line: curve id (a straight sketch line, along the sketch's normal)

label: Press Pull
params: face: [x,y,z] and distance: expr (positive adds material, negative cuts), or edges: [[x,y,z]…] and distance (a fillet)

params: bodies: [names]; translate?: [x,y,z] (exprs or numbers); axis?: [x,y,z]; angle?: expr; copy?: bool (default false: keeps the original bodies and transforms a new copy instead of moving them in place); occurrences?: [occurrence paths, root first] (only with copy: each component is copied as an independent component, as Paste New copies it, and the copy moves by the same translate, axis and angle in the world; the reply lists the copies in occurrences)

label: Coil
params: diameter; two of revolutions (or turns), height, pitch; section_size; section?: circular|square; section_position?: inside|center|outside; base?: [x,y,z] (numbers in mm or length expressions; default: the origin); axis?: X|Y|Z|[x,y,z] (default Z); start_angle?; clockwise?: bool; sketch? (a sketch; its plane is the section plane, so its placement sets the radius and start phase), profiles? (default: all; one closed profile without holes); operation?, targets?, name?, body_name?

label: Rib
params: sketch, curves: [open curve ids, in order]; thickness (across the sketch plane, or across the curves when normal); depth? (default: to the next face); flip?: bool (fill to the other side); direction?: in_plane|normal (grow across the sketch plane, the default, or along its normal)

params: sketch, curves: [open curve ids] (one wall each); thickness; depth? (default: to the next face); flip?: bool; direction?: in_plane|normal

label: Emboss
params: sketch, profiles?; depth; mode?: emboss|deboss; targets?; face?: world point [x,y,z] selecting a planar or complete exterior cylindrical wall (inferred when exactly one supported tangent cylinder matches the selected profiles)

params: faces: [[x,y,z] points on planar faces, or face names from model.faces]; target: plane (XY|XZ|YZ|construction plane|{origin, normal}) | target_face: [x,y,z] on a parallel planar face; body?

params: bodies: [names]; from: [x,y,z] | "origin" | {snap: vertex|edge_mid|face_center|circle_center, at: [x,y,z]} | from_face: [x,y,z] | from_plane: XY|XZ|YZ|construction or offset plane name or id|{origin, normal}; to: (the same) | to_face: [x,y,z] | to_plane: (a plane as from_plane; the point or face goes onto it along its normal, and the plane may move later: the bodies follow); faces and planes also turn to meet; flip?: bool; axes?: [x, y, z] (point-to-point only: which world axes the offset moves along; default all three, at least one true)

label: Point At Vertex

label: Point Through Three Planes

label: Point At Center Of Circle/Sphere/Torus

label: Point At Edge And Plane
params: edge: edge or line ref; plane: plane or planar face ref; name?

params: path: edge or sketch curve ref; t: expr, 0…1 along it (default 0.5); name?

label: Midplane

label: Plane Through Two Edges
params: a, b: straight edge or line refs in one plane; name?

label: Plane Through Axis And Point
params: axis: origin axis, construction axis, straight edge or sketch line ref; point: off-axis point ref; name?
